title: Kidnapped Woman Rescued After High-Speed Chase
description:
Bodycam footage shows a shocking incident unfolding as police in Miami Gardens, Florida, launch a high-speed, multi-county pursuit of a U-Haul van following a reported potential kidnapping. The chase comes to a dramatic end with the arrest of suspects Joe McKenzie, 39, and Brandon Spivey, 35, both with extensive criminal histories. However, the story takes a sharp turn when the alleged victim reveals more information. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
